paite: Huan hichi ahi a, kulhbang lamkhit a hih a, kongkhakte ka tun khita, kongkhakngakmite leh lasamite leh Levi mite seh a hih khit nung un,
english: Now it happened, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

paite: Ka unau Hanani, leh Hanania kulh ukpa kiangah Jerusalem kepna ka piaa: mi ginom ahi a, tampi sanga Pathian laudansiam a hih jiakin.
english: that I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the castle, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

paite: Huan a kiangah, Ni a sat mateng Jerusalem kongpite hon hi kei hen; huan galvila a din lai un, kong khakte khak uhenla, amaute kalhkhum un: huan Jerusalema tengte vengmi sep inla, mi chih amah dinmunah, mi chih amah in jawn chiat ah.
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

paite: Huan khopi a jain a liana: himahleh huaiah mite a tawm ua, inte lah lam ahi kei uh.
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

paite: Huchiin ka Pathianin ka lungtang miliante, vaihawmmite, mipite, kaikhawm dingin a koiha, huchia khangsutnaa sim a hih theihna ding un. Huan a masapena honglang amaute khangsutna laibu ka mutaa, huaiah gelha om ka mu:
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found written therein:

paite: Hiaite bial naupangte ahi ua, Nebukadnezzar Babulon kumpipan a pimangte, huai pimanga omte laka saltanna kipana piakhe toute, Jerusalem leh Judaa kik nawn, mi chih amah khopia kik;
english: These are the children of the province, who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city;

paite: Zerubbabel, Jesua, Nehemia, Azaria, Raamia, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilsan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baana toh hong paite.
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

paite: Israel mite laka pasal zah: Paros tate, sangnih za khat leh sawmsagih leh nih.
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

paite: Sephatia tate, za thum sawmsagih leh nih.
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

paite: Ara tate, za guk sawmnga leh nih.
english: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty-two.

paite: Pahath-moab, tate, Jesua leh Joab tate, sang nih leh za giat leh sawmlehgiat.
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

paite: Elam tate, sang khat za nih sawmnga leh li.
english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Zattu tate, za giat sawmli leh nga.
english: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty-five.

paite: Zakkai tate, za sagih leh sawmguk.
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.

paite: Binnui tate, za guk sawmli leh giat.
english: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty-eight.

paite: Bebai tate, za guk sawmnih leh giat.
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Azgad tate, sang nih za thum sawmnih leh nih.
english: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

paite: Adonikam tate, za guk sawmguk leh sagih.
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-seven.

paite: Bigvai tate, sang nih sawmguk leh sagih.
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand sixty-seven.

paite: Adin tate, za guk sawmnga leh nga.
english: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty-five.

paite: Ater, Hezekia tate, sawmkua leh giat.
english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

paite: Hasum tate, za thum sawmnih leh giat.
english: The children of Hashum, three hundred Twenty-eight.

paite: Bezai tate, za thum sawmnih leh li.
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-four.

paite: Harip tate, za khat leh sawmlehnih.
english: The children of Hariph, one hundred twelve.

paite: Gibeon tate, sawmkua leh nga.
english: The children of Gibeon, ninety-five.

paite: Beth-lehem leh Netophah tate, za khat sawmgiat leh giat.
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, one hundred eighty-eight.

paite: Anathot mite, za khat sawmnih leh giat.
english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Beth-azmaveth, mite sawmli leh nih.
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth, forty-two.

paite: Kiriathjerim, Kephir, Beer-oth tate, za sagih sawmli leh thum.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

paite: Rama leh Geba mite, za guk sawmnih leh khat.
english: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

paite: Mikma tate, za khat leh sawmnih leh nih.
english: The men of Michmas, one hundred and twenty-two.

paite: Beth-el leh Ai mite, za khat sawmnih leh thum.
english: The men of Bethel and Ai, a hundred twenty-three.

paite: Nebo dang mite, sawmnga leh nih.
english: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.

paite: Elam dang tate, sang khat za nih sawmnga leh li.
english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Harim tate, za thum leh sawmnih.
english: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

paite: Jeriko tate, za thum sawmli leh nga.
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

paite: Lod, Hadid leh Ono tate, za sagih sawmnih leh khat.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-one.

paite: Sena tate, sang thum za kua leh sawmthum.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred thirty.

paite: Siampute: Jedaia tate, Jesua inkuan akipan, za kua sawmsagih leh thum.
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

paite: Imer tate, sang khat sawmnga leh nih.
english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

paite: Pasur tate, sang khat za nih sawmli leh sagih.
english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

paite: Harim tate, sang khat leh sawmlehsagih.
english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

paite: Levi mite: Jesua, Kadmiel tate, Hodeva tate, sawmsagih leh li.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah, seventy-four.

paite: Lesamite: Asaph tate, za khat sawmli leh giat.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred forty-eight.

paite: Kongkhakngakte: Sallum tate, Ater tate, Talmon tate, Akkub tate, Hatita tate, Sobai tate, za khat sawmthum leh giat.
english: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, one hundred thirty-eight.

paite: Nithinim mite: Ziha tate, Hasupha tate, Tabbaoth tate;
english: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

paite: Keros tate, Sia tate, Padon tate;
english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

paite: Lebana tate, Hagaba tate, Salmai tate;
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

paite: Hanan tate, Giddel tate, Gahar tate;
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

paite: Reaia tate, Rezin tate, Nekoda tate;
english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

paite: Gazzam tate, Uzza tate, Pasea tate;
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah.

paite: Besai tate, Me-unim tate, Nephusesim tate;
english: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

paite: Bakbuk tate, Hakupha tate, Harhur tate;
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

paite: Bazlit tate, Mehida tate, Harsa tate;
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

paite: Barko tate, Sisera tate, Tema tate;
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

paite: Nezia tate, Hatipha tate.
english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

paite: Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai tate, Sophereth tate, Perida tate;
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

paite: Jaala tate, Darkon tate, Giddel tate;
english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

paite: Sephatia tate, Hattil tate, Pakereth-hazzebaim tate, Amon tate.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Amon.

paite: Nithinim mite tengteng leh Solomon sikhate tate, za thum leh sawmkua leh nih.
english: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

paite: Huan hiaite Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Kerub, Addon leh Immer akipan pai toute ahi uh: himahleh a pipute uh inkote, hiam a chi uh hiam, Israel akipan ahi hia chih a ensak theikei uhi:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel:

paite: Delaia tate, Tobia tate, Nekoda tate, za guk sawmli leh nih.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty-two.

paite: Siampute akipan: Hobaia tate, Hakkoz tate, Barzillai tate, Gilead mi Barzillai tanute laka zi neipa, a min uh tama minsak.
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

paite: Hiaiten khangthusuinaa sima omte lakah a mingelhna uh a zong uh, himahleh muhin a om kei: huaijiakin nin a sim ahi ua siamputna akipan koihkhiak.
english: These searched for their geneological records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore were they deemed polluted and put from the priesthood.

paite: Huan ukpipain a kiang uah, siampu khat Urim leh Thummim toh a hongsuah mateng thil siangthou penpente laka a nek louh ding uh ahi chih a gen a.
english: The governor said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, until there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

paite: Omkhawmte tengteng a vek un sing li leh sang nih leh za thum leh sawmguk,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

paite: A pasal sikhate uh leh a nungak sikhate uh, sang sagih za thum sawmthum leh sagihte, sim louhin: huan pasal lasa leh numei lasa za nih sawmli leh nga a nei uhi.
english: besides their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven: and they had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

paite: A sakolte uh za sagih sawmthum leh guk; a sakolneute uh, za nih sawmli leh nga;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

paite: A sangawngsaute uh, za li sawmthum leh nga; a sabengtungte uh sang guk za sagih leh sawmnih.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

paite: Huan pipute inkote laka lupente lak akipan khenkhatte nasem dingin a kipia uh. Ukpipain sumbawm ah dangkaeng darik sang khat, maiphiatkuang sawmnga, siampute puan za nga leh sawmthum a pia hi.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

paite: Huan pupute inkote laka lupente laka khenkhatten dangkaeng darik sang sawmnih leh, dangka puan sang nih leh za nih a pia uhi.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

paite: Huan mipitelaka adangdangte piak dangkaeng darik sang sawmnih leh dangka puan sang sawmnih leh, siampute puan sawmguk leh sagih ahi.Huchiin siampute leh, Levi mite leh, kongkhakngakte leh lasamite leh, mite laka a khente leh, Nethinim mite leh Israel tengteng a khopite uah a tengta uhi. Huan a kha sagihna a hongtunin, Israel tate a khopite uah a om uhi.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

paite: Huchiin siampute leh, Levi mite leh, kongkhakngakte leh lasamite leh, mite laka a khente leh, Nethinim mite leh Israel tengteng a khopite uah a tengta uhi. Huan a kha sagihna a hongtunin, Israel tate a khopite uah a om uhi.
english: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
